description: 卡罗-坎恩推进 B12 — 关键时机：c5兑换与Nxd4兑换中心马

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Practice 9: Caro-Kann Advance
This game has two linked timing decisions: when to challenge White's center with ...c5, and when to exchange after White's knight reaches d4. Track how one timely decision sets up the next.
intro.popup:
关键时机练习9

卡罗-坎恩推进变例！

c5兑换是关键选择
中局还有Nxe5时机判断

练习目标：
识别两个连续的时机节点

outro.popup_en: Three timing points: play ...c5 so that after dxc5 the bishop can recapture actively with ...Bxc5; exchange with ...Nxd4 immediately after White's knight occupies d4; then reroute the knight from b8 back to c6 to renew pressure. Timing is a sequence, not a single isolated move.
outro.popup:
卡罗时机总结

三个时机层次：
① c5！：dxc5后Bxc5优化象
② Nxd4！：Wd4入中心后立即兑换
③ Nc6！：Nb8-Nc6重新进中心

时机是连续的！

moves.popup_en: e5 advances in the Caro-Kann Advance Variation.
...Bf5 develops the bishop outside the pawn chain.

moves.popup:
c5！时机！
反制白方中心
moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black chooses the moment to counter White's center.
Nd2 develops and supports the center.
...Qb6! Black's queen becomes active and creates threats.
Nd4! White's knight occupies a central square.

moves.popup:
Nxd4！时机！
立即兑换白方强马
moves.popup_en: ...Nxd4! Black exchanges immediately after the knight reaches its strong central square.
cxd4 recaptures and opens the c-file.
Rb1 places White's rook on the b-file.

moves.popup:
Nc6！马重进中心
攻凼d4兵
moves.popup_en: ...Nc6! The knight returns to the center and attacks White's d4-pawn.
